limitation: PAPER only. 10x isolated-style simulations; fixed test FX KRW 1500 per USD for all category displays; sampled mark liquidation approximation; funding not modeled; no same-cycle re-entry after liquidation; no real orders.
whale_filter: Initial WHALE positions follow immediately. After a WHALE source flip, close immediately but require the new direction to persist into the next observation before re-entry.
swing_filter: SWING holds positions for at least 60 minutes unless liquidation. After minimum hold, an opposite signal must persist for 2 observations before exit; no same-cycle reverse entry.

swing_capital_policy.allocation: equal across current entry targets from remaining account capital
